settings.title: Two cakes at 5am. One in the pocket for mile 20.
settings.body: 26.2 miles rim to floor and back. The gels sometimes stop going down, the cake did not.

settings.caption: Snack when wet from the trail
settings.title: 9 miles trail run
settings.body: I bought a pair of trail shoes at Yellow Post in Big Bear Lake, we went for a 9 miles run from the lake, then up and down. Was starving at the end.

settings.caption: Waiting for Breakfast
settings.title: Breakfast in seconds
settings.body: You wake up in an isolated forest, our Sweet Potato Vanilla Cake is the perfect quick breakfast when you don't want to set up everything!

settings.title: Where it has been.
settings.intro: Notes from the road, the trail and the 5am kitchen. Kept short, kept honest.
